verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers ROCm software/ML framework support and general AMD Software features, but contains no data on the RX 9070 XT's TDP/TGP, power connector requirements, or cooling/case guidance. This axis clearly applies to a GPU purchase decision, but no evidence in the pack addresses it. Missing for 10: published TDP/TGP wattage, PCIe power connector spec (e.g., number of 8-pin or 12V-2x6), minimum PSU recommendation, case/cooling clearance guidance.
